gen-gf-gugi-gf-smooch-sans: Gugi draws every letter as one tube of constant weight. Smooch Sans follows in a tightly packed sans-serif line, its s generously open, so a longer passage moves along dense but never feels choked.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Sofia Sans Condensed has a big x-height and curves that stop short of closing their loops, looking friendly against Gugi's bold display. A longer passage reads quick and compact.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters in one bold stroke, with lowercase nearly the height of its capitals, under Gugi's display swagger. Its strongest trait is that mechanical precision.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-tiny5: Gugi bends its letters like tubing, with tall lowercase that nearly touches the capitals. And Tiny5 is the plain sans partner, so tall that its ascenders look short, doing the quiet work.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-truculenta: Truculenta packs short ascenders and a tall x-height into a compact line, with rounded forms that stay open to the side. Gugi is best at bold, distinctive display, while Truculenta just handles steady sans text.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-ubuntu: Gugi runs one unmodulated line through every glyph, tall lowercase nearly reaching its capitals. And Ubuntu, a modern sans with a lofty lowercase band, reads smoothly and confidently over a longer stretch.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads precise and structured, with loose spacing and bowls left unfinished on one side. Gugi supplies the bold display punch above, while Victor Mono lays out the monospace text beneath it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-viga: Viga reads smooth and businesslike, its capitals barely taller than the letters around them, with no hairlines or shadows. Gugi does bold, distinctive display best, while Viga handles the sans-serif text quietly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-voces: Tall, tidy lowercase meets a bold tubular display, with Voces keeping stems and hairlines in a close ratio beside Gugi. Gugi's diagonals stay thick, while Voces thins only slightly at its curves.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-winky-rough: Gugi gives every line a smooth, tube-like look, with tall lowercase nearly matching its capitals. And Winky Rough, a contemporary sans whose body height nearly matches its capitals, follows with matching sturdiness.
